About Us

About Us

Bryson Berard's Inspirational Journey

Bryson Berard’s journey to founding In The Light Roofing is a testament to dedication, faith, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Established in 2017 in the heart of Lehigh Valley, Bryson’s vision was to create a roofing company that transcended the norm. Driven by a lifelong passion for roofing and an unyielding strength drawn from his faith, family, and friends, Bryson set out to infuse every project with integrity, quality, and a sense of community.

In The Light Roofing quickly became more than just a service provider; it became a symbol of trust and reliability. Bryson and his team are not just roofers; they are guardians of comfort and safety, understanding that a roof is not merely a structure but a sanctuary for those beneath it. With each shingle laid, they weave a promise of durability, efficiency, and aesthetic appeal, ensuring that clients feel not only protected but also valued.

The company’s commitment extends beyond roofing. In The Light Roofing stands as a beacon of generosity, consistently supporting local causes and strengthening the community that has embraced and supported them. This philanthropic spirit is woven into the very fabric of the company, illustrating that success is not just measured in roofs repaired or installed but in lives positively impacted.

Bryson’s leadership and the team’s craftsmanship have earned accolades and trust across Lehigh Valley, with glowing reviews and numerous referrals speaking volumes of their dedication. Clients don’t just get a roofing contractor; they gain a lifelong partner, a protector, and a friend. In The Light Roofing’s story is one of resilience, innovation, and unwavering commitment to excellence, setting a new standard in the roofing industry and inspiring others to believe that with faith, integrity, and hard work, any dream is within reach.

Our Process

01

Begin with a Call

Your journey to a new roof starts with a phone call, where we listen to your needs and start forming a plan tailored just for you.
02

Personalized Appointment

We meet you at your convenience to understand your vision and discuss the possibilities for your roofing project.
03

Customized Estimate

Receive a detailed, transparent estimate that respects your budget and outlines our high-quality services.
04

Seamless Pre-Production

We smoothly transition to the planning stage, securing your commitment with a deposit that marks the beginning of our exceptional craftsmanship.
05

The Big Day: Transforming Your Space

Experience the magic on production day as we turn your roofing dreams into reality, ensuring every detail is perfected to your satisfaction.
